content: BIBREF56 use a GNN for hierarchical classification into a large taxonomy of topics. This task differs from traditional document classification. The authors represent documents as unweighted, undirected word co-occurrence networks with word embeddings as node features. They then use the spatial GNN of BIBREF15 to perform graph classification.
